endorsedOutput.text:
This week we're looking at what's actually working for engineering teams right now — not theory, just what teams tried and what happened.

## Structured onboarding cuts ramp time

Teams that moved to a fixed four-day onboarding structure saw new-hire ramp time drop 47% [1] compared to their old ad hoc process.

## Async standups are gaining ground

A few teams we talked to have replaced daily video standups with async written updates, citing fewer interruptions during deep-work blocks.

— The Acme Weekly Team
